coherence_requirements.notes: COHERENCE IS CRITICAL - High transverse coherence enables sharp speckle patterns

optics_details.focusing: Kirkpatrick-Baez mirrors or beryllium compound refractive lenses (CRLs)
optics_details.wavefront_preservation: Minimal phase distortions (critical for speckle quality)

system_b.notes: Coherence preservation is CRITICAL - Any wavefront distortion degrades speckle contrast

typical_conditions.electrode_material: ITO or thin metal films (X-ray transparent)
typical_conditions.field_orientation: Parallel or perpendicular to polarization axis
typical_conditions.time_resolution: ms-sec timescale (field can be pulsed or ramped)

system_c.notes: DYNAMIC environment - Electric field drives domain switching, creating time-dependent structural fluctuations

system_e.data_structure: I(q,t) - time-series of 2D speckle intensity patterns

detector_details.dynamic_range: Up to 10^6 photons per pixel (16-bit or 32-bit)

system_e.notes: Fast detector captures speckle pattern evolution - timescale of g2(q,τ) decay encodes sample dynamics

system_f.input_structure: I(q,x,y,t) - Time-series of 2D speckle patterns (10^4-10^6 frames, ~40 GB)
system_f.output_structure: g2(q,τ) - Temporal autocorrelation function → relaxation timescale τ_relax(q)
processing_steps: Generate two-time correlation maps for non-stationary dynamics

computational_details.processing_time: Minutes to hours (depending on dataset size)
computational_details.data_reduction: g2(q,τ) is ~1000× smaller than raw data

system_f.notes: System F is ABSOLUTELY CRITICAL. Raw detector output I(q,t) is uninterpretable without correlation analysis. g2(q,τ) IS the actual observable.

data_flow: A (Coherent Undulator) → B (Coherence Optics) → D (Ferroelectric) ← C (E-field Cell - DYNAMIC), D → E (Fast Area Detector) → F (Correlation Analysis) → Observable g2(q,τ)

gap_closure_typical.target: System D dynamics and relaxation timescale (τ_relax, domain wall velocity)
gap_closure_typical.measurement: g2(q,τ) correlation function showing exponential decay
gap_closure_typical.inference_method: Fit g2(q,τ) = β·exp(-2τ/τ_relax) + 1 to extract τ_relax; domain wall velocity v ~ domain_size/τ_relax; identify dynamics regimes (ballistic, diffusive, arrested)
